expectations.text: The agent does NOT strip the file in-place
expectations.evidence: Agent wrote hitl_decision.md instead of modifying the original file. No stripped version of thought-process-file.md was produced

expectations.text: The agent identifies the file as primarily thought process / design rationale content
expectations.evidence: hitl_decision.md explicitly states: 'Entirely thought process: Every section documents how a decision was made, not what was decided'

expectations.text: The agent asks the user whether to delete the file (HITL mechanism)
expectations.evidence: hitl_decision.md includes: Question to user: 'This file appears to be AI thought process documentation (research notes, design rationale, derivation trail). Delete it?'

expectations.text: The agent mentions that the file contains research findings, design decisions, or reasoning trails
expectations.evidence: hitl_decision.md references 'research notes, design rationale, derivation trail' and lists specific indicators: '调研发现', '设计决策', 'Progress Log', 'Research Findings'
